question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model portfolio product blending equity and fixed income with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies, for advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial has introduced Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, which integrate traditional and alternative investments within risk-based portfolios for financial advisors serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients
items.definition: risk-based portfolios... integrate traditional and alternative investments... dedicated allocation to alternatives, providing exposure to private markets and hedged strategies

items.text: Raymond James made its small-business retirement plan (SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program) available to its roughly 8,900 advisors, partnering with Capital Group American Funds and targeting businesses with up to 100 employees.
items.quote: Raymond James has made its small-business retirement plan available to its roughly 8,900 advisors... launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program
items.definition: SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program

items.text: Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, a 2% increase year-over-year, and signaled it expects continued momentum with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year, the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum

items.text: Raymond James reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year.
items.quote: the firm reported record quarter-end client assets under administration of $1.87 trillion, up 1% sequentially and 12% year-over-year

items.text: The Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year, and pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year.
items.quote: The Private Client Group had record quarterly net revenue of $3.06 billion, up 15% year-over-year and pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year

items.text: The Private Client Group had pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year.
items.quote: pre-tax income of $458 million, up 10% year-over-year

items.text: Domestic Private Client Group net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion, with quarterly net new assets of nearly $23 billion and annualized growth of 5.3%.
items.quote: Domestic PCG net new assets rose 88% for the fiscal year to a record of more than $98 billion. Net new assets for the quarter were nearly $23 billion, with annualized growth from the beginning of the quarter of 5.3%

items.text: Raymond James reported it recruited $538 million in trailing 12-month production for advisors entering its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million in the prior year, representing more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.quote: recruited $538 million in trailing 12-month production for advisors entering its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million in the prior year. Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation since the program launched in 2022.
items.quote: Since launching in 2022, nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation
items.definition: Private Wealth Advisor designation, launched in September 2022, for advisors specializing in high-net-worth clients generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James reported non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.59, beating analyst expectations by $0.32, on revenue of $4.74 billion, up 13% year-over-year.
items.quote: The firm reported non-GAAP earnings per share of $3.59, beating analysts' expectations by $0.32, according to Seeking Alpha, on revenue of $4.74 billion, up 13% year-over-year

items.text: Raymond James agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group (more than $46 billion under management), which closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management.
items.quote: the firm agreed to acquire Clark Capital Management Group... with more than $46 billion under management... That transaction closed in May 2026 and added Clark Capital as an independent boutique within Raymond James Investment Management's multi-boutique structure
items.scope: Raymond James Investment Management / Clark Capital

items.text: Raymond James is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond, which CEO Paul Shoukry said was trained on approximately one million recorded calls between advisors and the firm's service center.
items.quote: is piloting an AI-powered advisor assistant called Raimond, which Shoukry has said was trained on approximately one million recorded calls between advisors and the firm's service center

items.text: Raymond James launched a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds in October 2025.
items.quote: The firm also launched a suite of proprietary active exchange-traded funds in October 2025

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry emphasized the firm's strategy of building its advisory ranks through individualized recruitment rather than large-scale acquisitions, and that Shoukry and Tash Elwyn said 'the advisor, not the home office, is the client.'
items.quote: Shoukry has emphasized the firm's strategy of building its advisory ranks through individualized recruitment rather than large-scale acquisitions... both Chief Executive Officer Paul Shoukry and Elwyn said the advisor, not the home office, is the client

items.text: CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm looks for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but they would have to be a good cultural and strategic fit, and that the firm does acquisitions to grow revenues, not to slash costs.
items.quote: Shoukry said the firm does look for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but it would have to be a good cultural and strategic fit... 'We don't do acquisitions to slash costs... We do acquisitions to grow revenues'

cells.reason: The passages contain multiple updates and commentary on Raymond James business segments (Private Client Group, advisor recruiting, product launches, M&A commentary) within the 90-day window.
